title: Are men at greater risk for Parkinson's disease than women?
claim: PD incidence is higher in men
evidence_quote: the relative risk being 1.5 times greater in men than women

title: Gender differences in Parkinson's disease.
claim: Later onset and more tremor-dominant presentation in women
evidence_quote: Age at onset was 2.1 years later in women (53.4 years) than in men (51.3 years)
notes: Introduction: age at onset and presentation; abstract also reports women more often presented with tremor (67% vs 48%)

title: Unveiling sex-based differences in Parkinson's disease: a comprehensive meta-analysis of transcriptomic studies.
claim: Transcriptomic sex differences in PD described in post-mortem brain
evidence_quote: sex-labeled transcriptomic data from three relevant brain tissues: the frontal cortex, the striatum, and the substantia nigra
notes: Introduction: molecular sex differences studied mainly in brain

title: Systems level analysis of sex-dependent gene expression changes in Parkinson's disease.
claim: Transcriptomic sex differences in PD described in post-mortem brain
evidence_quote: we conducted a meta-analysis of disease-associated molecular sex differences in brain transcriptomics data from case/control studies
notes: Introduction: molecular sex differences studied mainly in brain

title: Multi-Omics Factor Analysis-a framework for unsupervised integration of multi-omics data sets.
claim: MOFA infers latent factors shared across or specific to data modalities
evidence_quote: It disentangles axes of heterogeneity that are shared across multiple modalities and those specific to individual data modalities

title: MOFA+: a statistical framework for comprehensive integration of multi-modal single-cell data.
claim: MOFA+ models multiple sample groups (multi-group MOFA; mofapy2)
evidence_quote: allowing to jointly model variation across multiple sample groups and data modalities

title: The Parkinson Progression Marker Initiative (PPMI).
claim: PPMI enrolls recently diagnosed PD and healthy controls
evidence_quote: The PPMI cohort will comprise 400 recently diagnosed PD and 200 healthy subjects

title: RNA sequencing of whole blood reveals early alterations in immune cells and gene expression in Parkinson's disease.
claim: Source of PPMI and PDBP whole-blood RNA-seq; PD alters blood cell composition signals
evidence_quote: including an early and persistent increase in neutrophil gene expression, with a concomitant decrease in lymphocyte cell counts
notes: Methods (RNA-seq data source); Discussion (Factor 1 as possible cell composition)
